items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I think it was Ray Bonitas, Augie Chalang, Myer Wine Boyd, Julian Langan, Shawkey.

ctx.x: Who was in that band anyway?
I think it was Ray Bonitas, Augie Chalang, Myer Wine Boyd, Julian Langan, Shawkey. I think that was about it.
What did Myer Wine Boyd play? Clarinet.
